articles.summary: A fill-in-ready RFP template for loan origination and decisioning software, with sample requirement language and a weighted scoring matrix. It also covers third-party risk management under the 2023 interagency guidance, so procurement, IT, and lending teams can compare vendors with confidence.
articles.title: RFP Template for Loan Origination and Decisioning Software

articles.summary: Cash flow underwriting uses permissioned bank account data to show how borrowers earn, spend, and repay, alongside traditional credit files. This guide covers the consumer and business signals that matter, the benefits, the compliance points, and a step-by-step framework for implementation.
articles.title: What Is Cash Flow Underwriting? A Guide for Modern Lenders
